name: Craft Youth Culture teen program
what_you_do: A free program for high school students. Teens visit galleries, talk about art, work with contemporary artists, and do hands-on artmaking projects and guest talks.
who_can_apply: Los Angeles-based youth who are incoming 9th to 12th graders (or homeschool equivalent). No art experience is needed. No age range is listed.
pay_detail: Free to join, with free museum admission. A $100 stipend is awarded when you complete the program. The museum can provide a rideshare if you need help getting there.
duration: Saturdays, 10:30 am to 1 pm, October 3, 2026 to May 1, 2027
deadline_text: 2026 to 2027 applications were due August 3, 2026, and accepted students were told by September 11, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form on the program page when the next cycle opens. If you do well, you are asked to a group interview. Questions: 323-937-4230 or kate@craftcontemporary.org.
notes: Next year's dates are not posted, so the dates above are from the 2026 to 2027 cycle. The program page's web address still says 2025-26, but its title and dates are 2026-2027. The page does not mention a work permit. The permit field is false because it is described as an after-school program with a completion stipend, not a job.
